hardwareScope.note: Street/Sport/Track are experimental ECU settings. No validated air-versus-coilover performance comparison exists.

metadata.luaRuntime: LuaJIT 2.1 via Lupa 2.6, numeric core only
metadata.purpose: Offline control experiment, not Xiaomi calibration or AC game measurement
metadata.units: SI internally; x forward, y left, z up; wheel order FL FR RL RR
metadata.metricsPolicy: Common kinematic yaw target vx*delta/L for RMS; not a manufacturer path target. Whole-profile comparison mixes pedal, caps, TC, yaw and braking; ablation disables yaw-request TV and ESC only.
metadata.sourceMapPolicy: MAP_1 fixed in all control modes to isolate ECU changes
metadata.reference: Fixed 22/78 + simple .28 TC/.12 ABS + 64% brake bias + original nonrecoverable COAST_REF
metadata.tireModel: Warm constant-mu tanh forces plus combined force circle; no thermal or DWB reconstruction
metadata.validDomain: Forward planar driving; no roll, pitch, wheel-hop, full aerodynamics, or hardware delays
